correctness.rationale: Exact SPD system reduction gives positive denominator. A pointwise exponential inequality proves every outer weight positive. The center numerator factors into strictly positive terms times F_b. For b>sqrt(5/6), F_b has strictly negative cubic coefficient; for b<=sqrt(5/6), an elementary lower bound and globally positive power-series induction prove F_b>0, including equality. Flat limiting weights follow from series and the kernel system. Independent exact symbolic identities and 90-digit matrix solves ran from the included verifier; finite checks supplement but do not replace proof.
